question_en: Have you ever applied to work for, worked for, or received an employment-related service from the Government of Canada?
proposed_question_en: Have you applied for a federal job or worked for one?

question_en: Have you ever applied for or received a federal benefit, grant, loan, reimbursement or other payment?
proposed_question_en: Did a federal program give you money or other help?

question_en: Have you filed federal taxes, paid federal duties, or made a customs declaration?
proposed_question_en: Did you ever file federal taxes or declare goods at the border?

question_en: Have you used a Canadian immigration, refugee, visa, permanent-residence or citizenship process?
proposed_question_en: Have you applied to move to Canada, stay here or become a citizen?

question_en: Have you applied for a Canadian passport, crossed Canada’s border, or joined a trusted-traveller program?
proposed_question_en: Have you applied for a passport, crossed the border or used NEXUS?

question_en: Have you received a federal health, dental, rehabilitation, disability or medical-device service?
proposed_question_en: Did a federal health program give you care or support?

question_en: Have you used a federal service specifically for First Nations, Inuit or Métis people?
proposed_question_en: Have you used a federal service for First Nations, Inuit or Métis people?

question_en: Have you served in the Canadian Armed Forces or used a federal veterans program?
proposed_question_en: Have you served in the Armed Forces or received help as a veteran?

question_en: Have you applied for federal student aid, an apprenticeship, scholarship or training program?
proposed_question_en: Has the Government of Canada helped pay for your school or job training?

question_en: Have you been involved in a matter handled by federal law enforcement, security screening or corrections?
proposed_question_en: Did you have a security check or deal with a federal law officer, prison or parole?

question_en: Have you made a complaint, grievance or appeal to a federal institution or tribunal?
proposed_question_en: Did you file a complaint or ask a federal office to review a choice it made?

question_en: Have you made an access-to-information, personal-information access, or correction request?
proposed_question_en: Have you asked a federal office for records about you or to fix your records?

question_en: Have you owned or operated a business, held a federal licence or permit, or contracted with the federal government?
proposed_question_en: Did you run a business, get a federal permit or sell goods or services to the government?

question_en: Have you used a federal housing, mortgage, home-buying or property program?
proposed_question_en: Have you used a federal program to rent or buy a home?

question_en: Have you contacted a federal institution, joined a consultation, signed a petition, or participated in a federal election process?
proposed_question_en: Did you contact a federal office, share your views, sign a petition or vote?

question_en: Have you participated in or volunteered for a federally run cultural, sport, recreation, heritage or park activity?
proposed_question_en: Have you joined or helped with a federal arts, sports, heritage or parks event?

question_en: Have you taken part in federal research, a survey, testing or a focus group?
Have you requested or received federal help during an emergency, evacuation or disaster?
proposed_question_en: Did you ask for federal help in a crisis or after a disaster?

question_en: Have you used a federal service involving a birth, marriage, divorce, adoption, child support, death or estate?
proposed_question_en: Did you use a federal service for a birth, wedding, divorce, adoption or death?
